title: 经济·职业与青年现象
desc: 涵盖就业求职、职业规划、创业、毕业选择、乡村振兴、共同富裕与消费观等高频表达。

entries.example: After months of painstaking preparation, she finally landed a decent job in a reputable firm.
entries.exampleZh: 经过数月刻苦准备，她终于在一家知名企业找到了一份像样的工作。
entries.note: land 表“成功获得”，后接 job/offer；多用于尾段举例。

entries.example: In a saturated job market, graduates with practical skills are far more likely to be hired.
entries.exampleZh: 在饱和的就业市场中，具备实用技能的毕业生更容易被录用。
entries.note: 第二段析因时用；常作 in a saturated job market。

entries.example: Academic qualifications alone can hardly guarantee a rewarding career in today's economy.
entries.exampleZh: 在当今经济环境下，仅有学历很难保证拥有一份有回报的职业。
entries.note: 多用复数 qualifications；后接 for 表胜任某职位。

entries.example: Employers nowadays attach greater weight to professional competence than to paper certificates.
entries.exampleZh: 如今雇主更看重专业能力，而不是一纸证书。
entries.note: 不可数；搭配 professional competence，不加 -s。

entries.example: Mastering a second foreign language gives job seekers a distinct competitive edge.
entries.exampleZh: 掌握第二外语会让求职者拥有明显的竞争优势。
entries.note: 常搭配 give sb. a competitive edge；第二段论证用。

entries.example: Only those with genuine expertise can stand out from the crowd in a crowded market.
entries.exampleZh: 只有具备真才实学的人才能在拥挤的市场中脱颖而出。
entries.note: 介词固定用 from；尾段号召句谓语，主语常为 graduates。

entries.example: Sound career planning enables students to convert vague ambitions into concrete steps.
entries.exampleZh: 合理的职业规划能让学生把模糊的抱负转化为具体步骤。
entries.note: 不可数，前可加 sound/proper；中间段论证具体做法时作主语最合适。

entries.example: Setting a long-term goal prevents young people from drifting along with the tide.
entries.exampleZh: 设定长期目标能让年轻人不致随波逐流。
entries.note: 与 short-term goal 对举；搭配 set/pursue。

entries.example: Prospective employers tend to favor candidates who have relevant internship experience.
entries.exampleZh: 潜在雇主往往青睐有相关实习经历的应聘者。
entries.note: 只作定语，后接 employer；勿与 perspective 混淆。

entries.zh: 从事……职业，在……领域谋求发展
entries.example: Many graduates choose to pursue a career in education rather than in big cities.
entries.exampleZh: 许多毕业生选择从事教育行业，而不是留在大城市。
entries.note: 介词固定用 in + 领域；勿说 pursue a career of。

entries.zh: 做出明智而有依据的选择
entries.example: Only after weighing the pros and cons can graduates make an informed choice.
entries.exampleZh: 只有在权衡利弊之后，毕业生才能做出明智的选择。
entries.note: informed 意为“有依据的”；用于毕业选择类首段。

entries.example: Encouraged by preferential policies, more graduates start a business in their hometowns.
entries.exampleZh: 在优惠政策鼓励下，越来越多毕业生在家乡创业。
entries.note: 近义 set up one's own business；勿漏冠词 a。

entries.example: A successful entrepreneur must be both visionary and resilient in the face of setbacks.
entries.exampleZh: 成功的企业家必须既有远见，又能在挫折面前坚韧不拔。
entries.note: 可数，泛指用 an entrepreneur；勿与 enterprise 混。

entries.example: Cultivating an entrepreneurial spirit helps students turn innovative ideas into reality.
entries.exampleZh: 培养创业精神有助于学生把创新想法变为现实。
entries.note: 此处 spirit 不可数；形容词是 entrepreneurial，勿写错。

entries.example: Those unwilling to take calculated risks seldom reap the rewards of innovation.
entries.exampleZh: 不愿承担可控风险的人，很少能收获创新的回报。
entries.note: risk 用复数；常用 take calculated risks，较书面。

entries.example: Career choice should be based on personal strengths rather than on blind conformity.
entries.exampleZh: 职业选择应基于个人优势，而非盲目从众。
entries.note: 2013 年真题核心词；常与 be based on 搭配。

entries.example: For some graduates, further study is a wiser option than immediate employment.
entries.exampleZh: 对一些毕业生而言，继续深造比立即就业更明智。
entries.note: study 不可数；可换 pursue further education。

entries.example: Ambitious young people are more willing to embrace challenges beyond their comfort zone.
entries.exampleZh: 有抱负的年轻人更愿意接受舒适区之外的挑战。
entries.note: 为真题中 tame 的反义词；写作多取褒义。

entries.example: Rural revitalization has opened up unprecedented opportunities for college graduates.
entries.exampleZh: 乡村振兴为大学毕业生开创了前所未有的机遇。
entries.note: 官方固定译法，作主语时谓语用单数；中间段举例支撑论点时使用。

entries.example: Working at the grassroots level allows graduates to understand the real needs of farmers.
entries.exampleZh: 在基层工作能让毕业生了解农民的真实需求。
entries.note: 常用 at the grassroots level；名词形式不加 -s。

entries.example: Poverty alleviation has lifted millions of rural households out of absolute poverty.
entries.exampleZh: 扶贫工作使数百万农村家庭摆脱了绝对贫困。
entries.note: alleviation 拼写易错；动词搭配 alleviate poverty。

entries.example: Improving rural infrastructure is an effective way to narrow the urban-rural gap.
entries.exampleZh: 改善农村基础设施是缩小城乡差距的有效途径。
entries.note: narrow 作动词“缩小”；也可说 bridge the gap。

entries.example: Common prosperity calls for a more equitable distribution of social wealth.
entries.exampleZh: 共同富裕要求对社会财富进行更公平的分配。
entries.note: 官方术语，不可数；搭配 call for / pursue。

entries.example: A widening income gap may undermine social stability and public confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 不断扩大的收入差距可能损害社会稳定和公众信心。
entries.note: 常用 a widening income gap；narrow 表缩小。

entries.example: Governments should channel more resources to the underprivileged in remote areas.
entries.exampleZh: 政府应把更多资源投向偏远地区的弱势群体。
entries.note: the + adj. 表一类人，作主语时谓语可用复数；词尾永远不加 -s。

entries.example: An equitable education system gives every child a fair chance to succeed.
entries.exampleZh: 公平的教育制度让每个孩子都有平等的成功机会。
entries.note: 比 fair 更书面，多修饰 distribution；勿混 equality。

entries.example: Unbridled consumerism has driven many young people into heavy debt.
entries.exampleZh: 毫无节制的消费主义使许多年轻人负债累累。
entries.note: 不可数且多含贬义；常与 curb / resist 连用。

entries.example: Extravagant spending on luxury goods contradicts the virtue of thrift.
entries.exampleZh: 在奢侈品上的铺张消费与节俭的美德相悖。
entries.note: 常修饰 spending / lifestyle；可与 wasteful 互换。

entries.example: Prudent consumers always spend within their means instead of chasing trendy brands.
entries.exampleZh: 理性的消费者总是量入为出，而不是追逐时髦品牌。
entries.note: 固定搭配；反义为 live beyond one's means。

entries.example: Impulse buying is often triggered by aggressive online advertising and discount campaigns.
entries.exampleZh: 冲动消费往往由猛烈的网络广告和打折活动引发。
entries.note: 不可数；动词形式为 buy on impulse，第二段分析成因时使用。

entries.example: Advocating rational consumption helps young people resist the lure of material temptations.
entries.exampleZh: 倡导理性消费有助于年轻人抵制物质诱惑。
entries.note: 常与 advocate / promote 连用；与量入为出并列。

entries.zh: 无休止的激烈竞争，内卷式生活
entries.example: Trapped in the rat race, many young professionals sacrifice health for promotion.
entries.exampleZh: 困于无休止的竞争中，许多年轻职场人为晋升牺牲健康。
entries.note: 含贬义，前面加 the；常作 in the rat race。

entries.example: Facing cut-throat competition, graduates must sharpen their skills to survive.
entries.exampleZh: 面对残酷竞争，毕业生必须磨炼技能以求立足。
entries.note: cut-throat 是连字符形容词，不加 -s；比 fierce 更生动。

entries.zh: 躺平，选择不再拼命奋斗
entries.example: Some young people choose to lie flat rather than engage in pointless competition.
entries.exampleZh: 一些年轻人选择躺平，而不愿卷入无意义的竞争。
entries.note: 源自中文网络热词，正式写作中宜加引号；过去式是 lay flat，易写错。

entries.example: Peer pressure often pushes students to pursue goals that they do not truly value.
entries.exampleZh: 同辈压力常迫使学生追求他们并不真正看重的目标。
entries.note: 不可数；常搭配 under / yield to peer pressure。

entries.example: Many graduates feel anxious about an uncertain future and fierce workplace rivalry.
entries.exampleZh: 许多毕业生对不确定的未来和激烈的职场竞争感到焦虑。
entries.note: 搭配 be anxious about sth.，不用 on。

entries.example: Rather than follow the herd, students should weigh their own interests carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 学生不应随大流，而应仔细权衡自己的兴趣。
entries.note: herd 前加 the 且不加 -s；近义 follow the crowd。

entries.example: Every applicant deserves an equal opportunity regardless of gender or family background.
entries.exampleZh: 无论性别或家庭背景，每位求职者都应得到平等机会。
entries.note: 不可数，前用 an；谈就业公平议题时必用。

entries.example: Gender discrimination in recruitment deprives qualified women of fair competition.
entries.exampleZh: 招聘中的性别歧视使合格女性失去公平竞争的机会。
entries.note: 不可数，后接 against sb.；常与 combat 连用。

entries.example: Business integrity is the cornerstone of a company's long-term reputation.
entries.exampleZh: 商业诚信是企业长期声誉的基石。
entries.note: 不可数；可替换 honesty in business，论证企业责任。

entries.example: Once a firm loses its credibility, regaining customers' trust becomes extremely difficult.
entries.exampleZh: 企业一旦失去信誉，重获顾客信任就变得极其困难。
entries.note: 不可数；搭配 lose / enhance one's credibility。

entries.example: Young people should seize every opportunity to broaden their horizons abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻人应抓住每一个机会到国外开阔眼界。
entries.note: seize 比 take 更有力；后接 to do sth.。

entries.zh: 实现向上流动，实现阶层跃升
entries.example: Higher education remains a vital channel for rural students to achieve upward mobility.
entries.exampleZh: 高等教育仍是农村学生实现向上流动的重要渠道。
entries.note: upward mobility 为社会学固定表述；前用 achieve。

entries.en: It is advisable that college graduates should ___ before making a final decision.
entries.zh: 建议大学毕业生在做出最终决定前___。
entries.example: It is advisable that college graduates should weigh their strengths before making a final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 建议大学毕业生在做出最终决定前先衡量自身优势。
entries.note: 尾段提建议用；that 从句中用 should + 动词原形。

entries.en: Instead of ___ing aimlessly, young people ought to ___.
entries.zh: 年轻人不应漫无目的地___，而应当___。
entries.example: Instead of drifting aimlessly, young people ought to set a clear goal for themselves.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻人不应漫无目的地漂浮，而应为自己设定明确目标。
entries.note: 对比句式，用于第二段批判现象后提出正确做法；ought to 后接动词原形。

entries.en: Faced with the choice between ___ and ___, a growing number of graduates ___.
entries.zh: 面对___与___之间的抉择，越来越多的毕业生___。
entries.example: Faced with the choice between further study and employment, a growing number of graduates hesitate.
entries.exampleZh: 面对深造与就业之间的抉择，越来越多的毕业生犹豫不决。
entries.note: 毕业选择类首选句式；a growing number of 后接复数。

entries.en: Only by ___ can fresh graduates stand out in a fiercely competitive job market.
entries.zh: 只有通过___，应届毕业生才能在激烈的就业市场中脱颖而出。
entries.example: Only by sharpening practical skills can fresh graduates stand out in a fiercely competitive job market.
entries.exampleZh: 只有磨炼实用技能，应届毕业生才能在激烈的就业市场中脱颖而出。
entries.note: Only by 置于句首引起部分倒装，助动词 can 必须提到主语之前。

entries.en: What matters most in career planning is not ___, but ___.
entries.zh: 职业规划中最重要的不是___，而是___。
entries.example: What matters most in career planning is not a high salary, but lasting personal growth.
entries.exampleZh: 职业规划中最重要的不是高薪，而是长久的个人成长。
entries.note: 主语从句作主语，谓语用单数 is；构成 not...but... 对比。

entries.en: It is ___ that enables young people to ___.
entries.example: It is unremitting effort that enables young people to turn dreams into reality.
entries.exampleZh: 正是坚持不懈的努力使年轻人能够把梦想变为现实。
entries.note: 强调句式，去掉 It is...that 后句子仍完整；强调人时也可用 who。

entries.en: There is no denying that ___ plays an indispensable role in ___.
entries.zh: 不可否认，___在___中起着不可或缺的作用。
entries.example: There is no denying that entrepreneurial spirit plays an indispensable role in economic vitality.
entries.exampleZh: 不可否认，创业精神在经济活力中起着不可或缺的作用。
entries.note: 第二段点明主题；role 前用 an，不可省略。

entries.en: The more ___, the more likely young people are to ___.
entries.example: The more practical experience they accumulate, the more likely young people are to seize rare opportunities.
entries.exampleZh: 他们积累的实践经验越多，年轻人就越可能抓住难得的机会。
entries.note: 比较级平行结构，前后须对称；注意后句系动词 are 的位置不能提前。

entries.en: It is high time that we ___ instead of ___.
entries.example: It is high time that we reflected on what true success means instead of following the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 我们早该思考真正的成功意味着什么，而不是随大流。
entries.note: 从句用过去式或 should + 动词原形，尾段呼吁。

entries.en: Where there is a will, there is a way.
entries.example: Where there is a will, there is a way, and perseverance finally pays off in the job hunt.
entries.exampleZh: 有志者事竟成，坚持不懈终会在求职中获得回报。
entries.note: 谚语，可独立成句或作尾段首句；后接 and 分句时句首字母大写。

entries.zh: 机遇眷顾有准备的头脑。
entries.example: Fortune favors the prepared mind, so graduates should hone their skills well in advance.
entries.exampleZh: 机遇眷顾有准备的头脑，因此毕业生应提前磨炼技能。
entries.note: 巴斯德名言；论证“准备与机遇”时用，英式拼写也可写作 favours。

entries.en: Strike while the iron is hot.
entries.example: Strike while the iron is hot, and never let a golden opportunity slip away.
entries.exampleZh: 要趁热打铁，绝不要让良机悄然溜走。
entries.note: 祈使句；尾段号召抓住机遇时可用。
